script.text: According to the retrieved document: Vitals must be stable for 12 consecutive hours before discharge.

turns.say: how many hours must vitals be stable before a patient can be discharged

reference: Vitals must be stable for 12 consecutive hours before discharge.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: A glucose level above 250 raises a critical red alert.

turns.say: what glucose level triggers a critical red alert

reference: A glucose level above 250 raises a critical red alert.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: Suspend the drug and treat it as an adverse drug reaction, which must be logged.

turns.say: what do we do if a patient gets a rash after a drug

reference: Suspend the drug and treat it as an adverse drug reaction, which must be logged.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: Routine follow-ups must be scheduled at least 48 hours in advance.

turns.say: how far in advance must routine follow up visits be booked

reference: Routine follow-ups must be scheduled at least 48 hours in advance.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: Insulin and heparin need an independent double-check by two nurses.

turns.say: double check requirement for insulin and heparin

reference: Insulin and heparin need an independent double-check by two nurses.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: Use non-beta-lactam antibiotics for a penicillin allergy.

turns.say: which antibiotics can be used if the patient is allergic to penicillin

reference: Use non-beta-lactam antibiotics for a penicillin allergy.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: The attending physician must sign off before an emergency patient is released.

turns.say: who must sign off before an emergency patient is released

reference: The attending physician must sign off before an emergency patient is released.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: Urgent consultation requests are routed to the Triage Nurse.

turns.say: urgent consultation request who handles it

reference: Urgent consultation requests are routed to the Triage Nurse.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: A late cancellation needs supervisory approval.

turns.say: who needs to clear a cancellation made the day before the visit

reference: A late cancellation needs supervisory approval.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: A level 2 emergent patient must be seen within 10 minutes.

turns.say: how long can an emergent level 2 patient wait for a physician

reference: A level 2 emergent patient must be seen within 10 minutes.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: Facial droop, arm weakness and speech difficulty trigger a neurology referral.

turns.say: signs of a stroke that should trigger a neurology referral

reference: Facial droop, arm weakness and speech difficulty trigger a neurology referral.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: No, insulin needs a second nurse for the double-check.

turns.say: can one nurse alone give insulin

reference: No, insulin needs a second nurse for the double-check.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: A beta-lactam allergy changes the antibiotic choice at discharge.

turns.say: what happens to the antibiotic choice at discharge when the patient has a beta-lactam allergy

reference: A beta-lactam allergy changes the antibiotic choice at discharge.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: The attending physician must sign the electronic discharge summary.

turns.say: what does the attending physician have to sign before discharge

reference: The attending physician must sign the electronic discharge summary.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: An adverse drug reaction must be logged within 4 hours.

turns.say: within how many hours must an adverse drug reaction be logged

reference: An adverse drug reaction must be logged within 4 hours.

script.text: According to the retrieved document: A cancellation with short notice needs supervisory approval.

turns.say: what is the rule for cancelling an appointment with 12 hours notice

reference: A cancellation with short notice needs supervisory approval.
